evals.prompt: Make a landscape product shot for my coffee brand Harbor Roast using the attached brand guidelines. Scene: a ceramic mug of fresh coffee sitting on a weathered dock railing, the harbor and boats behind it, warm early-morning light. Follow the brand style from the guide.
evals.expected_output: A generated landscape image saved to a file, preceded by the pipeline trace: a Visual Design DNA extracted from the reference guidelines, design concepts, the one concept chosen, and a scorecard showing the image passed evaluation (overall >= 4.0/5) with the five criterion scores. The image should visibly follow the Harbor Roast palette (ink/paper/ember/harbor/sand) and warm-coastal voice.
assertions: A .png image file was generated in the outputs directory
The generated image is landscape (width greater than height)
report.md documents the Visual Design DNA extracted from the reference guidelines
report.md contains an evaluation scorecard with the five criteria and a numeric overall score
The image was accepted only after passing the gate (overall >= 4.0 and pass is true)
The generated image visibly uses the Harbor Roast palette (ink/paper/ember/harbor/sand) and a warm coastal mood

The brief's condition adjective is honoured rather than tinted: the railing is visibly weathered (silvered or greyed grain, lengthwise splits or checking, softened arrises, lichen or salt bleaching) and not new, smooth, uniform timber
The trace names the provider and model that produced the image

evals.prompt: Design a square poster for a beach-volleyball tournament called "Summer Smash". It should be bright, bold and energetic — think hot summer sun, sand, a ball arcing over a net. No reference image; invent a fitting visual identity from the description.
evals.expected_output: A generated square image saved to a file, with the pipeline trace: style DNA derived from the brief text, design concepts, chosen concept, and a scorecard showing evaluation passed. The image should match the brief (square, bright/bold, volleyball scene, poster feel).
assertions: A .png image file was generated in the outputs directory
The generated image is square (width equals height)
report.md documents a style DNA derived from the brief text (no reference image was supplied)
report.md contains an evaluation scorecard with the five criteria and a numeric overall score
The image was accepted only after passing the gate (overall >= 4.0 and pass is true)
The image matches the brief: a bright, bold, energetic summer beach-volleyball scene with a ball and net
The depicted scene is physically coherent: the two opposing players are on opposite sides of the net, and the action happens over sand rather than open water
The image contains no text beyond the text the brief requested (no invented taglines, badges or wordmarks)
The trace names the provider and model that produced the image

evals.prompt: Make a UI mockup of a desktop web landing page for a focus-timer product called "Flowstate". Landscape, 16:9. Calm and minimalist, generous whitespace, soft teal accent, modern sans-serif type.
evals.expected_output: A generated landscape image of a UI mockup saved to a file, with the pipeline trace and a passing scorecard. The mockup should look like a clean productivity-app landing page (hero, headline, call-to-action) matching the calm/minimal/teal brief.
assertions: A .png image file was generated in the outputs directory
The generated image is landscape (width greater than height)
report.md documents a style DNA derived from the brief (no reference image was supplied)
report.md contains an evaluation scorecard with the five criteria and a numeric overall score
The image was accepted only after passing the gate (overall >= 4.0 and pass is true)

The image reads as a landing-page UI mockup with structure beyond a hero section: a headline plus at least one of a nav bar, a supporting sub-head, or a secondary section, in a calm, minimalist style with a teal accent
Every string of text rendered in the image is correctly spelled and legible

The timer dial is self-consistent with its own readout under a convention the image itself fixes: the filled fraction of the ring matches the value printed inside it (a dial labelled "remaining" is a countdown, so the filled arc is the time remaining), measured to within about 10 percentage points
The image was produced by the layout route (HTML/CSS authored and rasterised at 2x), which the skill makes the default for landing-page briefs carrying more than a phrase of legible type

Any interactive or transient state in the mockup (popup, toast, tooltip, dropdown, modal, hover highlight, drag ghost) has a visible cause in the same frame — a cursor on its trigger, a highlighted active control, or a dimmed backdrop. A transient element with no cause anywhere in the frame fails, as does one contradicted by its own copy
The trace states how the image was produced — the provider and model for a diffusion route, or the rasteriser for a layout route
